lines: 如果我问你：明天会下雨吗？你心里其实有一个模糊的把握。
If I ask whether it will rain tomorrow, you already have a vague sense of it.
这种把握有多确定？这一期，我们用一个数把它量出来：熵。
How certain is that sense? This episode measures it with one number: entropy.
先记住一句话：熵，是一个分布平均有多意外。
Start with one sentence: entropy is how surprised a distribution is on average.
第一个关键词，不确定性。结果越分散，越难猜。
The first word is uncertainty: the more spread out the outcomes, the harder to guess.
第二个关键词，平均。不是某一次，而是长期平均。
The second word is average: not one draw, but the long-run average.
第三个关键词，下界。它决定了编码一个结果，平均至少要多少比特。
The third word is lower bound: the minimum average bits needed to encode an outcome.
把一个分布写成概率 p。
Write a distribution as probabilities p.
信息量是负 log p：概率越小，意外越大。
Information is negative log p: the smaller the probability, the bigger the surprise.
按概率加权平均，就得到熵的公式。
Average it with the probabilities, and you get the entropy formula.
画出来看：横轴是概率 p，纵轴是负 log p。
Plot it: probability p on the x-axis, negative log p on the y-axis.
p 接近 1，信息量接近 0；p 接近 0，曲线陡峭上升。
As p approaches 1, information approaches 0; as p approaches 0, the curve climbs steeply.
把这条曲线按 p 加权平均，就是熵。
Average this curve with weights p, and you get entropy.
这一期，我们把熵拆成三个词、一个公式、一条曲线。
This episode reduced entropy to three words, one formula, and one curve.
下一章，我们用它来衡量语言模型。我们下期见。
Next chapter, we use it to measure language models. See you next time.
